This implementation adds UX improvements to the Episodes page filters:

2. Add active filter chips showing currently applied filters with individual remove (x) buttons
3. Sync filter state with URL query parameters for shareable/bookmarkable views
4. The existing pagination (issue #12) and API route already work correctly - no backend changes needed

### Subtask 1.2: Wrap component with Suspense and implement URL sync
**File**: `/Users/paulbrown/Desktop/coding-projects/podcast/web_ui_hosted/app/episodes/page.tsx`
**Pattern**: Follow `app/login/page.tsx` lines 115-127 for Suspense wrapper
**Instructions**:
1. Rename `EpisodesPage` to `EpisodesContent`
2. Create new `EpisodesPage` export that wraps `EpisodesContent` in `Suspense`
3. Add `useSearchParams()` and `useRouter()` hooks at the top of `EpisodesContent`
4. Initialize filter state from URL params on mount
5. Update URL when filters are applied

**Code Changes**:
```typescript
// At top of EpisodesContent function (after renaming)
function EpisodesContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  // Initialize filters from URL on mount
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    q: searchParams.get('q') || '',
    status: searchParams.get('status') || '',
    sortBy: searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'scored_at',
    sortDir: searchParams.get('sortDir') || 'desc'
  });
  const [pendingFilters, setPendingFilters] = useState({
    q: searchParams.get('q') || '',
    status: searchParams.get('status') || '',
    sortBy: searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'scored_at',
    sortDir: searchParams.get('sortDir') || 'desc'
  });
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(
    parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '0')
  );
  // ... rest of state

// Function to update URL with current filters
const updateUrl = (newFilters: typeof filters, page: number) => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (newFilters.q) params.set('q', newFilters.q);
  if (newFilters.status) params.set('status', newFilters.status);
  if (newFilters.sortBy !== 'scored_at') params.set('sortBy', newFilters.sortBy);
  if (newFilters.sortDir !== 'desc') params.set('sortDir', newFilters.sortDir);
  if (page > 0) params.set('page', String(page));

  const queryString = params.toString();
  router.push(queryString ? `/episodes?${queryString}` : '/episodes', { scroll: false });
};

// At bottom of file
export default function EpisodesPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="bg-white shadow rounded p-6">
          <div className="animate-pulse">
            <div className="h-8 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/4 mb-4"></div>
            <div className="h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-full mb-2"></div>
            <div className="h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-3/4"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    }>
      <EpisodesContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors

// Add computed value in component
const hasActiveFilters = filters.q || filters.status ||
  filters.sortBy !== 'scored_at' || filters.sortDir !== 'desc';

// Add removeFilter function
const removeFilter = (key: keyof typeof filters) => {
  const defaultValues: typeof filters = {
    q: '',
    status: '',
    sortBy: 'scored_at',
    sortDir: 'desc'
  };
  const newFilters = { ...filters, [key]: defaultValues[key] };
  setPendingFilters(newFilters);
  setFilters(newFilters);
  setCurrentPage(0);
  updateUrl(newFilters, 0);
  loadEpisodesWithFilters({ ...newFilters, page: 0 });
};
